## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## 🎯 Use Case
Describe the problem or need this feature addresses. Why is this feature important?

## 💭 Proposed Solution
Describe what you want to happen or how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Game Component
Which part of the game would this feature affect?
- [ ] Core Gameplay
- [ ] Alliance System
- [ ] Combat Mechanics
- [ ] Resource Management
- [ ] World Map
- [ ] User Interface
- [ ] Audio/Visual
- [ ] AI/NPC
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: [Please describe]

## 🎨 Implementation Ideas
If you have specific ideas about how this could be implemented, please share them:
- **Technical approach:** [e.g. Unity C# script, Python server, AI algorithm]
- **Data structure:** [e.g. JSON config, database schema, class design]
- **UI/UX:** [e.g. menu design, interaction flow]

## 📈 Impact Assessment
How would this feature impact the game?
- **Player Experience:** [e.g. More strategic depth, better immersion]
- **Development Complexity:** [e.g. Low, Medium, High]
- **Performance:** [e.g. Positive, Neutral, Negative]
- **Content:** [e.g. New gameplay options, expanded content]

## 🔗 Related Issues
Is your feature request related to any existing issues?
- Related to # (issue number)

## 🖼️ Mockups/Wireframes
Do you have any visual mockups, wireframes, or sketches that show what this feature might look like?

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## 🎮 Game Design Context
How does this feature fit with the overall game vision of النسر الدامي (Bloody Eagle)?
- **Islamic-Andalusian Theme:** [e.g. architectural elements, cultural aspects]
- **Mongolian Fusion:** [e.g. strategic elements, design aesthetics]
- **MMO Strategy:** [e.g. multiplayer dynamics, strategic depth]
